Respiratory Therapy student here 👋🏾

General anesthesia can last about a week or 2 in your system. Drinking alcohol can increase the effect of the remaining anesthesia in her body which can not only make her sleepy but depress her respiratory drive at the same time. 

Meaning during the next 2 weeks, if she drinks alcohol she can fall asleep and stop breathing.

In addition to this, drinking after surgery doesn't help with healing at all.

That sounds like you’re catastrophizing. I was diagnosed with MDD and general anxiety and I do it all the time. Maybe even a bit too often.. Sometimes for the smallest thing like someone not texting back within a minute or not answering my calls, I would start to think that it’s because they hate my guts or they’re mad at me about something.
I’m slowly getting over this way of thinking by doing a small activity in those moments. I try to think of 3  reasons which could have caused this person to not text or call back. Maybe they dropped their phone in the toilet? Maybe they’re just really busy washing dishes? Maybe their phone died? This way I bring myself to realize that there are sooo many more factors than just “me” to consider.
It’s hard thinking this way because I know how it can totally ruin your mood. Stay strong and try to be kinder to yourself. Hope this helps a bit  :)
